classes.name: ActionExecutionModule
classes.description: Deep private Sekai module whose interface concentrates live Action admission, policy outcomes, dry-run, approval hold, denial, limits, schema validation, effect execution, audit, metering, security refresh, and Catalog invocation receipt completion.

classes.name: SekaiGrpcTransportAdapter
classes.description: gRPC adapter that authenticates callers, correlates capability-catalog invocations, checks live capability visibility, maps protocol messages and response metadata, and delegates governed Action execution.

classes.name: GovernedActionLifecycleModule
classes.description: Sekai-owned module that resolves action policy, coordinates budget and blast-radius limits, binds policy attestations, commits generic approval transitions, and owns execution outcome and limit-denial audit ordering with post-effect metering.

classes.name: CatalogInvocationReceiptLifecycleModule
classes.description: Deep private module whose interface owns pending Catalog invocation receipt creation, policy and budget decision tracking, fail-closed completion, durable event ordering, uncovered surfaces, and approval continuation.

relations.name: delegates_action_execution_to
relations.description: The gRPC transport delegates governed Action admission and every admitted outcome after authenticating the caller, resolving catalog correlation, and checking live capability visibility.

relations.name: uses_governed_action_lifecycle
relations.description: Action execution resolves one governed Action lifecycle context and uses it for policy, approval, limit, audit, and metering behavior.

relations.name: completes_catalog_invocation_receipt_through
relations.description: Action execution reports policy and budget decisions and completes catalog-attributed outcomes through the Catalog invocation receipt lifecycle.
